summary.text: BENTSENJORDET BORETTSLAG (957 299 296), a housing cooperative, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1990-02-26; address Nedre Torggate 5/7, 3015 DRAMMEN, Norge. Main industry is Activities of housing cooperatives (97.001); 1 registered sub-unit(s). Board chair: Bjørn Harald Bråthen; Auditor: ØSTLANDSKE REVISORER AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 524.81 k, operating profit NOK 269.01 k, net profit NOK 34.98 k, equity NOK -167.66 k, total assets NOK 4.68 m. The registry lists the website https://www.nbbo.no, but its content could not be verified.
